thread:
Maya Luo: Quick check on Playground stream UX — two quick things: Stop vs Regenerate placement, and token counter when inserting prompts. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/shot.png

Ryan Chen: Make Stop primary when streaming. Left position, filled destructive style, Esc hotkey. Regenerate secondary.

Jules Park: Accessibility: announce start/stop via aria-live polite. Token counter should read "Token estimate: N, updating" then "Tokens: N" when final.

Samira K.: Bug: inserting from prompt library then stopping mid-stream leaves token count stale. Fix options: live estimate during stream -> flip to final, or dim it. Prefer live estimate plus final flip.

Kevin O.: Tab order up next: Stop -> Regenerate -> Prompt library. Also focus composer after insert. Stop touch target >=44px.

ui-test-bot: A11y smoke: token pill contrast failing in dark theme. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/11001/report

Maya Luo: Plan: small PR with (1) button reorder + Esc, (2) aria-live for stream + token, (3) token contrast tweak and badge flip. Will ping for reviews.

Ryan Chen: +1. Keep Stop idempotent.

Jules Park: +1 for aria changes.

Samira K.: Will validate the token flip behavior.

Maya Luo: Thanks — PR coming. :thumbsup:
